events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman known for Oasis and Beady Eye, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine', featuring his signature song, was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine the impact
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine' – an album that still resonates today. Which track takes you back?

events.title: The original iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple launched the very first iPod in 2001, revolutionising how we carry our music.

angles.name: Pocket full of tunes
angles.copy: Remember the first time you put '1,000 songs in your pocket'? The original iPod is 25 today! What was the first album you loaded on yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic spy franchise and its enduring legacy.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and which theme tune is the ultimate Bond anthem?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Imagine a world with John
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. What's the one song that always reminds you of him?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Ministry of Silly Walks and more
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' 58th Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: A blank canvas of sound
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unveiled their groundbreaking 'White Album'. Which track from this diverse masterpiece is your go-to?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury

angles.name: The show must go on
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' 61st Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A pivotal album
angles.copy: 61 years of 'Rubber Soul'! This Beatles album marked a significant shift in their sound. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: We mark the 46th anniversary of the tragic passing of John Lennon.

angles.name: A voice for peace
angles.copy: 46 years ago, the world lost a musical legend. Remembering John Lennon and his powerful message of peace and love today. Which of his songs means the most to you?
